sources.name: whisper-turbo-card.md
sources.inspection_note: This fixed turbo repository is an ASR/speech-translation checkpoint; transcription predicts same-language text, rather than a conversational answer. Read card attribution: partly Hugging Face, partly original card.
sources.short_excerpt: For speech recognition, the model predicts transcriptions in the same language as the audio.
